articles.summary: Summit Therapeutics Inc. (NASDAQ: SMMT) today announced the successful closing of AstraZeneca’s (LSE/STO/NYSE: AZN) strategic equity investment in Summit. The equity investment will support continued acceleration of the development of ivonescimab, a novel, potential first-in-class investigational PD-1 / VEGF bispecific antibody. Pursuant to the terms of the Securities Purchase Agreement entered into by Summit and AstraZeneca, AstraZeneca purchased an aggregate of approximately 108,955 shares of preferred stock convertible into shares of common stock of Summit at a 1:1,000 ratio. The investment by AstraZeneca totaled $2.0 billion. At the conversion ratio, the investment represents a common stock price equal to $18.36, representing a premium over the closing trading price on the day the investment was announced. articles.summary: Research Will Use Lunit’s AI-powered Pathology Platform to Analyze HE Whole-Slide Images and Generate Scalable Insights into Tumor Microenvironment Biology Summit Therapeutics Inc. (NASDAQ: SMMT) and Lunit Inc. (KRX: 328130) today announced a research agreement to evaluate the use of Lunit SCOPE IO, Lunit’s AI-powered pathology platform, for tumor microenvironment analysis in support of Summit’s immuno-oncology development programs with ivonescimab. The effort will focus on applying Lunit SCOPE IO to hematoxylin and eosin-stained (HE) whole-slide images to characterize tumor microenvironment features. The companies aim to explore how AI-powered pathology analysis can support biomarker discovery, patient stratification or selection, and a deeper biological understanding of response to ivonescimab therapies. articles.summary: Highlights Include Phase II Data Supporting Clinical Development Expansion for Ivonescimab Summit Therapeutics Inc. (NASDAQ: SMMT) today announced that ivonescimab data will be featured in numerous presentations at the European Society for Medical Oncology 2026 Congress (ESMO 2026), taking place October 23-27, 2026, in Madrid, Spain. Across 10 presentations at ESMO 2026, ivonescimab data will span a broad range of tumor types, led by positive overall survival findings from Akeso Inc.’s Phase III HARMONi-GI1 study of ivonescimab plus chemotherapy compared to durvalumab plus chemotherapy in first-line advanced biliary tract cancer, which is selected as a Late-Breaking Abstract for the Presidential Symposium. HARMONi-GI1 is a multi-center, Phase III study conducted in China and sponsored by Akeso, with all relevant data exclusively generated, managed, and analyzed by Akeso. The study (SMT112-216 / AK112-216 / NCT07877194 ) is being conducted in collaboration with Summit’s partner, Akeso Inc.
